ruling.reasoning:
The driver cancelled this trip and picked "rider_no_show" as the reason, with a $5.00 fee on record [F3], so NS-0 routes the case to NS-1 / NS-2. The trace settles the NS-1 elements: (i) fails because the "I'm Here" tap at 13:01:00 was made 599 m from the pickup point and the driver never came within 200 m [F6][F1][NS-1]; (ii) fails because the driver was stationary at 599 m from 13:01:00 to cancellation at 13:04:30, 0 s counted at the pickup and short of the 5-minute free wait from the later of arrival and scheduled time [F2][F3][F5][NS-1]; (iii) passes — 2 in-app messages (first 13:01:25) and 1 in-app call (first 13:02:30) before cancelling [F4][NS-1]. A single failed NS-1 condition voids the fee in full [NS-2].

The driver's written statement that he pressed "I'm Here", called and waited more than 5 minutes "at the pickup" [F14] conflicts with the GPS and timeline records; system records override statements, so the statement cannot support the charge [F1][F2][F5][NS-1]. The rider's message at 13:02 reporting she was at the pickup point with no car there [F10] matches the GPS position 599 m away [F1][F2], not the driver's 13:01 claim to be "here already" [F9].

The trace marks NS-2 satisfied: arrival was confirmed while the driver was not at the pickup point, which requires a flag_account in addition to the refund [F6][F1][NS-2]. NS-9 is not engaged — the rider has 0 disputes and 0 upheld in the last 90 days [F18], so no rider-side repeat flag applies [NS-9]. RD-6 is not cited: this is a no-show case, not a route deviation, and no route case is upheld here.

Amount: the disputed charge is the no-show cancellation fee of $5.00 on record [F7][F3], with a 1.0× multiplier and no surge component [F8]; the fee is voided in full, so the refund is the fee on record = $5.00 [NS-2].
